empirical_scope: Small internal CV evaluation and controlled synthetic perturbation/sequence studies; no eligible multimodal civic cases.

research_stage_table.main_finding: Framework and baseline-protection behavior are exercised by the R0 test suite.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: Infrastructure tests are not a model-performance evaluation.

research_stage_table.sample_size: 122 images; 90 positive labels recorded in QA summary; 86/18/18 split
research_stage_table.metrics: QA reports zero exact duplicate groups, five near-duplicate pairs, no known cross-split leakage; 122/122 prior privacy-clear claims
research_stage_table.main_finding: A small structured CV dataset and QA artifacts exist.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: Source and license claims conflict; QA summary fields conflict with the dataset card/registry; provenance is not independently reconciled.

research_stage_table.research_question: D1 baseline, M1.13 reference, hard-negative and augmentation experiments
research_stage_table.dataset: D1; most evaluations on 18-image test split
research_stage_table.sample_size: 18 test images / 15 positive boxes for primary baseline
research_stage_table.model_checkpoint: CVR2-CV-001 to CVR2-CV-005; R2 candidate weights and M1.13 reference
research_stage_table.threshold: Evaluation-dependent; R2.1 found conf=0.001 metric reporting vs operational 0.25 analysis
research_stage_table.metrics: 001 reports mAP50 0.9507, mAP50-95 0.7959 at its validator protocol; 004 mAP50 0.9649 conservative vs 0.5714 strong
research_stage_table.main_finding: Aggressive augmentation degraded the recorded test mAP relative to conservative augmentation; R2.1 rejects the hard-negative suppression claim as unsupported.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: Small D1 split, threshold mismatch in early records, and experiment.json statuses still say PLANNED while metric records say COMPLETED.

research_stage_table.research_question: Metric consistency and scientific audit of R2
research_stage_table.dataset: R2 artifacts; D1/test and negative scenes
research_stage_table.sample_size: 18 test images, 15 boxes; 3 negative test scenes in cited audit
research_stage_table.model_checkpoint: R2 candidate checkpoints and frozen M1.13 reference
research_stage_table.threshold: Resolved as a mismatch between low-confidence validator metric and 0.25 operating analysis
research_stage_table.metrics: Independent audit reconciles low precision/recall claims and finds zero false detections at 0.25 for both hard-negative arms
research_stage_table.main_finding: Hard-negative false-positive reduction claim is unsupported; aggressive augmentation comparison is methodologically controlled.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: Audit inherits the small and provenance-uncertain D1 corpus.

research_stage_table.research_question: Robust baseline, corruptions, negative scenes, geographic slices, and failures
research_stage_table.sample_size: 18 test images; all 15 positive boxes are road_waterlogging; 32 negative scenes for R3-008
research_stage_table.main_finding: Fixed-threshold D1/test detections and controlled error/negative-scene analyses are recorded.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: No class 0/1 test support, small single-source test split, and source/geography claims are not independent ground truth.

research_stage_table.research_question: Independent D2 cross-dataset and geographic generalization
research_stage_table.model_checkpoint: R3 checkpoint was not evaluated on D2
research_stage_table.main_finding: No cross-dataset result; source admission stopped on provenance and independence issues.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: D2 absent; claims about generalization remain unanswered.

research_stage_table.sample_size: 18 source images, 15 boxes; 396 generated copies across 22 conditions
research_stage_table.metrics: Clean primary P=0.7895, R=1.0000, F1=0.8824, mAP50=0.99125; condition-specific fixed-threshold changes recorded
research_stage_table.main_finding: Model behavior varies across controlled perturbations; severe blur/noise demonstrate failures within tested conditions.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: Synthetic transformations of repeated small internal test sources are not external weather or real-world domain validation.

research_stage_table.dataset: Synthetic sequences derived from D1/test stills
research_stage_table.sample_size: 18 source images, 90 sequences, 900 frames; only road_waterlogging has positive support
research_stage_table.metrics: Five sequence families; e.g. quality degradation primary P=0.8828, R=0.8533, F1=0.8678
research_stage_table.main_finding: Temporal rules and controlled frame-level behavior were measured on synthetic sequences.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: No recorded real-world video; frames repeat/transform the same still-image sources.

research_stage_table.research_question: Can civic context improve multimodal evidence quality?
research_stage_table.dataset: R5/R6 provenance audit; no civic case set
research_stage_table.metrics: Descriptive source inventory; no case-level metric
research_stage_table.main_finding: Available controlled CV artifacts do not provide case-linked citizen, location, authority, or environment evidence.

research_stage_table.research_question: Can a legitimate civic case dataset be acquired and audited?
research_stage_table.metrics: D1-D0 exact/near overlap and split sequence audit; source admission audit
research_stage_table.main_finding: Case schema and provenance protocol are defined; no auditable multimodal source corpus could be admitted.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: D1 source claims and per-asset licenses remain unreconciled; R5/R6 are derived artifacts.

research_stage_table.research_question: Does multimodal evidence improve civic-case evaluation?
research_stage_table.main_finding: Protocol and epistemic safeguards are defined; no empirical comparison is possible.
research_stage_table.main_limitation: No case data; no baseline can be ranked.

final_regression.scope: R0-R10 research tests including R2.1, plus relevant M8-M12 regressions.
